version.changelog: 优化SKILL.md格式，提升灰色底色下的可读性

llm.summary: The skill's code and documentation mostly match its stated purpose (memory, knowledge graph, reports), but there are multiple inconsistencies (instruction-only vs. many code files, undocumented install steps, invisible unicode control characters in SKILL.md) that warrant caution before installing.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (memory, dynamic KG, report generation) align with the included Python modules (octo_memory, dynamic_kg, case_search, smart_executor, etc.). However the SKILL.md project structure references different filenames (memory.py, knowledge_graph.py, report.py) than the actual files present, the SKILL.md version (v1.0.2) differs from registry version (1.0.3), and the package declares 'instruction-only' / no install spec while many code files and publish scripts are present. These mismatches are inconsistent and should be clarified by the author.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions are generally scoped to the declared purpose and only list optional API keys for enhancement (OPENAI_API_KEY, PERPLEXITY_API_KEY, GROK_API_KEY). However the SKILL.md contains detected unicode-control-chars (prompt-injection signal) which can be used to hide or manipulate displayed content. The doc also states 'does not access sensitive files' but says configuration is stored under ~/.qiaomai/ — that is a user filesystem path the skill will write to, yet no required config paths were declared in metadata. The presence of publish scripts in the package raises the need to inspect what those scripts do at install/publish time.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Registry metadata lists 'No install spec — instruction-only', but the skill bundle includes many code files and publish scripts. The absence of an explicit, auditable install specification (how code will be placed on disk, whether any archives or network downloads occur) increases risk because it's unclear what will run during 'install' or when the agent imports the package. Review the publish_*.py and scripts to confirm whether they perform network operations or execute arbitrary code.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Declared required env vars: none. SKILL.md lists optional API keys for enhanced features (OpenAI, Perplexity, Grok) — those are proportionate to optional enhancements. No unrelated or excessive credentials are requested and primaryEnv is none.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true and does not claim elevated platform privileges. It will store configuration under ~/.qiaomai/ per the SKILL.md, which is normal for user-level tools but is not declared in required config paths in metadata. The skill can be invoked autonomously (default), which is standard — combine this with the earlier issues (install ambiguity, unicode-control-chars) before allowing autonomous use.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance:
Proceed cautiously. What to do before installing or enabling this skill:

- Verify source and provenance: the registry lists 'Source: unknown' and no homepage — prefer skills with identifiable authors or repository links.
- Inspect publish and script files (scripts/publish_*.py, build/scripts/*): check whether they make network requests, upload data, or execute shell commands. Search for 'requests', 'urllib', 'subprocess', 'os.system', or hard-coded endpoints.
- Open SKILL.md as raw bytes to confirm and remove any hidden unicode-control characters; treat those as suspicious unless explained.
- Because there is no install spec, ask the author how the package will be installed and what will run during installation. Do not run unknown install scripts on a production host; use a clean sandbox or disposable VM/container.
- Confirm whether the skill will write to ~/.qiaomai/ and inspect what files it stores there and with what permissions.
- If you intend to provide optional API keys (OpenAI, Perplexity, Grok), use least-privilege/test keys and monitor traffic; do not supply high-privilege account credentials without auditing network behavior.

If you cannot verify the above or if the publish scripts contact unfamiliar endpoints, treat the package as untrusted and avoid installing it on devices with sensitive data.
llm.findings: [unicode-control-chars] unexpected: Invisible/unicode control characters were detected in SKILL.md. For an instruction-only doc this is unexpected and can indicate an attempt to hide or manipulate displayed instructions or prompts. This is a red flag worth manual inspection of the SKILL.md (view raw bytes) to find any hidden content or direction.
